'''Subgroup analysis''' refers to repeating the [[analysis]] of a study within [[Subgroup|subgroups]] of subjects defined by a subgrouping variable. For example: [[smoking]] status defining two subgroups: smokers and non-smokers.<ref name="lagakos06">{{
cite journal
|author=Lagakos SW |author1-link=Stephen Lagakos
|journal=[[NEJM]]
|title=The Challenge of Subgroup Analyses — Reporting without Distorting
|date=20 April 2006
|volume = 354
|issue = 16
|pages = 1667–9
|pmid = 16625007
|doi=10.1056/NEJMp068070
|s2cid=567177
}}</ref>
